external_entities.name: Supplier
external_entities.description: Suppliers who upload compliance paperwork and sign in to the portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: Category manager
external_entities.description: Category managers who review uploaded paperwork and approve or reject it.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: Vendor
external_entities.description: The vendor that hosts the SaaS portal and pushes the nightly supplier data extract.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The portal is a SaaS product. The vendor hosts it

processes.name: Supplier document portal
processes.description: SaaS portal through which suppliers upload paperwork and category managers review and approve or reject it.

processes.name: Supplier master service
processes.description: Service that loads the nightly supplier data extract and writes the records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: Vendor platform
data_stores.description: Vendor-hosted platform where supplier compliance documents remain.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: Landing bucket
data_stores.description: Bucket in the organisation's cloud account receiving the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.

data_stores.name: Supplier database
data_stores.description: Database into which the supplier master service writes supplier records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database

data_flows.name: sign in
data_flows.description: Supplier signs in to the supplier document portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers sign in with a username and password that the vendor issues to them.

data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.description: Supplier uploads compliance paperwork and staff contact details to the portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff

data_flows.name: review paperwork
data_flows.description: Category manager reviews uploaded paperwork and approves or rejects it.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded supplier compliance paperwork and approval or rejection

data_flows.name: push extract
data_flows.description: Vendor pushes the nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: System description: "We were told the nightly extract is encrypted end to end." System description: "The runbook for the landing bucket says the file arrives as a plain CSV". These claims conflict, so encryption in transit is unknown.

data_flows.name: load file
data_flows.description: Supplier master service loads the nightly extract from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.description: Supplier master service writes supplier records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database
data_flows.data_description: Supplier records from the nightly extract

trust_boundaries.name: Vendor hosting
trust_boundaries.description: Vendor-controlled hosting environment for the SaaS portal and vendor platform.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The vendor hosts it and we do not run any part of it.

trust_boundaries.name: Corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: Corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: Cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: Organisation's cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The vendor platform is confidential because it holds compliance paperwork and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the vendor platform holds insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket is confidential because it holds a supplier data extract.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the landing bucket receives a supplier data extract.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database is confidential because it holds supplier records derived from the supplier data extract.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the supplier master service writes supplier records into the supplier database.
